paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with CAST-CAPP
suggested_experiment_name: CAST-CAPP (CERN Axion Solar Telescope - CAPP haloscope)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling as plotted on y-axis
notes: CAST-CAPP haloscope searched for dark matter axions in the mass range 19.74–22.47 μeV using four phase-matched rectangular cavities in the CAST dipole magnet at CERN. The experiment excludes axion-photon couplings down to g_agamma = 8×10^-14 GeV^-1 at 90% CL for virialized galactic axions. The bound is mass-independent across the scanned range and encoded as a horizontal line. Local DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm³ was assumed (standard galactic halo model). Data acquisition: 4124 h from 2019–2021.
